messages:
olivia_cust: Hey team — vendor escalated the SIG/CAIQ bespoke form due Fri. They specifically want: KMS export logs, HSM attestation, and a short sample of API auth failures seen during their export run yesterday. We hit a bunch of 401s. Need an evidence handback window and repro steps ASAP.

sam_cs: on it. can you share the vendor case id and the time range for their export? i’ll coordinate timeline for the handback window. :hourglass: 

olivia_cust: Case ID 9012-CUST. export window was ~2026-03-15 22:10–22:18 UTC. vendor says ~30% of objects failed with 401.

maria_sec: tagging in SRE/infra — do we have KMS key id and the HSM attestation doc requested? customer asked for chain + timestamped attestation. also need to confirm retention window for audit logs (they asked for last 90 days).

lee_sre: saw a small auth spike around that time correlated with a rolling hotfix earlier in the day. looks like a short TTL cache eviction on service tokens which caused retries -> 401s then client backoff. incident link: https://internal/incidents/INC-4521 (note: contains sensitive logs).

noah_eng: repro steps we used locally:

```
# simulate export run against export endpoint
for id in $(seq 1 500); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP_TOKEN" \
    "https://api.redwood-inference/v1/exports/object/$id"
done
```

Log filter to surface 401s: `jq -r '.timestamp + " " + .request.path + " " + .response.status' /var/log/redwood/api/*.log | grep 401`

Workaround: create short-lived export token scoped to `exports:read` and run replay within a controlled IP allowlist. we can produce the token and run a replay in a 1hr handback window.

sam_cs: Maria/Lee — can SRE confirm a 60-min window tomorrow (2026-03-18 15:00–16:00 UTC) for evidence replay? we need exported sample + signed HSM attestation + time-synced logs. customer requires chain and a short narrative of root cause.

maria_sec: can provide HSM attestation template. customer specifically requested FIPS/HSM firmware version and signing certificate thumbprint. need security sign-off before sending. :white_check_mark:

lee_sre: Confirmed for that window. will standby and snapshot logs + KMS audit trail. we’ll enable more verbose auth logging for that window so vendor sample contains the contextual fields they asked for.

billing-cs: heads up — the failed export triggered a billing dispute on the vendor side; they flagged overage credits since data export retried. if we perform the replay we may need to mark it as remediation replay to avoid billing impact. please confirm so i can handle the invoice note.

sam_cs: yes please mark as "remediation replay - no charge" for that export batch. billing-cs, i'll DM you the case details and the customer approval.

noah_eng: additional note — if customer uses on-prem private deployment for final attestation we need to ensure KMS key wrapping mode is compatible; otherwise provide cryptographic proof-of-possession via signed audit bundle. i can draft the bundle format.

olivia_cust: thanks all. we’ll accept the 2026-03-18 15:00–16:00 UTC window. please confirm the temporary token method and that logs will include the `x-request-id` header so vendor can correlate.

maria_sec: will include `x-request-id`, key id, and epoch timestamps. also will include a short attestation doc with cert thumbprint. i’ll draft and drop in the case by EOD PST. :memo:

lee_sre: deploy-bot: we’ll schedule the verbose auth logging toggle right before the window and revert after.

deploy-bot: deployment v1.12.3 -> auth-proxy toggles scheduled for 2026-03-18T14:55Z, revert 2026-03-18T16:10Z (automated).

sam_cs: thanks team. olivia, after the replay we’ll produce: 1) signed HSM attestation 2) KMS audit trail (90d slice) 3) sample export objects + manifest 4) RCA note for the 401 spike. can you confirm who on vendor side will receive artifacts so we can set ACLs?

olivia_cust: vendor contact is alice.vendor@thirdparty.com. please set S3 ACL to allow read for that principal and send a signed link.

maria_sec: ack. will attach the attestation and timestamp it. tagging @legal for export of attestation artifacts for recordkeeping.

sam_cs: closing loop — I’ll follow up after the replay with a summary and next steps. good job. :thumbsup:
